listen_addr.description: Plain HTTP address for the web API, normally behind a reverse proxy.

admin_password.description: Initial admin password. Keep this file mode 0600.

insecure_cookie.description: Send the session cookie without Secure. Only for a dashboard served over plain HTTP in development; behind a TLS-terminating proxy leave it off.

trusted_proxies.description: IP addresses or CIDR prefixes of reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For header names the client, so failed sign-ins are limited per client rather than per proxy.

state_dir.description: Durable state (host registry, secret store); defaults to the config file's directory.

ca_key_file.description: Control CA private key; the server signs agent and its own certificates with it.

credential_file.description: The server's own key and certificate chain in one PEM file, re-issued automatically.

server_names.description: DNS names and IP addresses agents use to reach the control listener.
